bullets.text: AI Roadshows for Accountants - Join the **Sage** AI Roadshows to explore practical AI adoption strategies for accounting practices.
Navigating MTD Challenges - With **Making Tax Digital** launching, accountants must adapt to increased client interactions and AI integration.
Understanding AI Archetypes - Discover three archetypes of AI adoption among accountants: **Strategic Adopters**, **Cautious Observers**, and **Digital Traditionalists**.
